Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated Richard N. Palmer (the American Connecticut Supreme Court justice) with a different person, “Richard Palmer (engineer)” (British), and directed the use of the engineer’s Wikipedia page as evidence. This name-disambiguation error and mis-specified sources (wrong person, wrong links) led to the incorrect inference that Palmer was British, which would produce the wrong conclusion about whether their nationalities match.
